description: Current standings or league table for a league. Returns team rank, W/L record (or points for soccer/NHL), division or conference, streak, and games behind. Omit season for the current year. NHL standings use points; soccer uses points-based league tables. Pages default to 100 rows, capped at 200; continue with nextOffset and the same league and season. Provider ranks preserve ties and are null when unavailable.

league.description: League identifier. Supported: nfl, nba, mlb, nhl, epl, mls, laliga, bundesliga, seriea, ligue1, ucl, ncaaf, ncaab.

limit.description: Standings rows per page, default 100; values above 200 are clamped and disclosed.

offset.description: Zero-based standings offset, default 0. Continue with nextOffset and the same league and season.

season.description: Season year, e.g. "2025". Omit for the current season.

name: sports_get_standings

availableStandings.description: Total standings rows in the acquired league season.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `season_not_found`: An explicit season year returned no standings or could not be verified against the provider season metadata. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Next standings offset; repeat the same league and season.

notice.description: Informational note, e.g. "Season not currently active" when standings are unavailable during the off-season.

season.description: The season queried, or null if current.

standings.description: Provider groups in source order; ranked rows sorted by group position, stable ties, unknown ranks last.

group.description: Upstream ranking group, conference, table, or MLB division name; null when unavailable.

overtimeLosses.description: NHL overtime losses; null when unavailable or inapplicable.

points.description: Points total (used in NHL and soccer).

rank.description: Provider rank within the group (1-based), null when unavailable.

source.description: Data source that provided this standings entry.

streak.description: Current streak code, e.g. W3 or L2.

ties.description: Number of ties (null if not applicable).

winningPercentage.description: Win percentage as a decimal string (NFL/NBA/MLB). Null for NHL.

totalReturned.description: Standings rows returned on this page.

truncated.description: Whether standings rows remain after this page.

unavailableSources.description: Failed optional contributions; successful records remain available.

reason.description: Provider contribution could not be obtained.

recovery.description: Safe guidance for retrying the missing contribution.

title: Sports Get Standings
